title: Lab Report

origin.title: CBC report format (Labsmart Software Sample Letterhead)
origin.clearance_note: LabSmart's own sample Complete Blood Count report, generated by its lab software on a 'Labsmart Software Sample Letterhead' and linked from its CBC report format page (labsmartlis.com/cbc-report-format); downloaded by script on 2026-10-03 and used unaltered. It is a vendor specimen: the lab's phone (+91 12345 67890), email (yourlabname@gmail.com) and website (yourlabname.in) are placeholders, the registration number is masked as XXXX54826XX, and both signatures are stamped SAMPLE. The patient name on it is part of the vendor's sample and is not featured. The ADE Documents shared drive held a different file under this request (doc1-lab-reports/demo_labs_cbc_1.pdf); it appeared to be an unattributed real patient report, so the operator rejected it and it was not parsed or used.

notes: The request named no feature page or fields. The four featured fields are one flagged result, the reason a lab report is read: the lymphocyte count of 18 %, below its reference range of 20-40 %. All read ok. Only the lower bound is featured because the low and high bounds share one cell ('20 - 40') and would draw the same box twice; the lower bound is the one the result falls below. The report's own 'L' flag beside the value is not captured: the team schema (used unchanged) has no field for an abnormal flag. Other schema mismatches, left as findings: lab_details requires address lines and a city that this letterhead does not print (null, with a nonconformant_output warning); report_status is required and not printed (null); the reference-range high field is spelled 'referecne_high' in the schema. The reported date-time is extracted correctly but normalised to ISO, so it grounds OFF.
